answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the harbor of a task receipt, and the falcon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The dune of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
